just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb4 and dwells most on Ak in Phrase 1. Phrase 4 (0:42.0) introduces D, Eb, centred on C. Phrase 8 (1:33.4) introduces Ck, centred on C. Phrase 13 (2:47.1) introduces Dk, Ek, F, centred on F. The line peaks at G5 (808.0 Hz) at 2:48.2. It closes on the tonic (Bb3 → Ak3 → G4 → G4 → G4 → G4).
